name: AC Transit
description: Student Transit Pass Program: free unlimited local bus rides for eligible Alameda County middle and high school students
fullDescription: AC Transit (Alameda-Contra Costa Transit District) is the third-largest public bus system in California, serving the East Bay including Oakland, Berkeley, and surrounding cities with local and transbay service.
whatTheyOffer:
- Student Transit Pass Program (STPP), run by Alameda CTC: free unlimited rides on AC Transit, Union City Transit, or Wheels (local routes serving your school) for eligible middle and high school students
- Transbay and BART trips are not free; students under 19 get the pass on a Youth Clipper card with 50% off BART and youth discounts elsewhere
- Valid year-round, including summer, until the student leaves high school
howToGetIt:
1. Check eligibility and apply online at alamedactc.org/programs-projects/studentpass
2. Once approved, a Youth Clipper card with the pass is mailed to your school (4-6 weeks or more); pick it up from your school's site administrator
3. If you already have a Youth Clipper card, the pass is loaded onto it within 2-4 weeks
4. Register the card in an online Clipper account so it can be replaced if lost
5. Questions: ask your school's site administrator or contact Alameda CTC (510-208-7400)
keywords: AC Transit, student pass, free bus, STPP, middle school, high school, Oakland, Berkeley, East Bay, Clipper, transit
